complaint: New subscriber devices fail to authenticate against the network captive portal when connecting via Wi-Fi or Ethernet. Both internet access and IPTV subscription validation are blocked.

attempted_actions.evidence: Clearing browser cookies and cache did not bypass the portal authentication loop.

observations: RADIUS authentication server drops packets due to secret key mismatch.
Subscriber management database lists account in suspended state.

resolution_steps.instruction: Re-synchronize RADIUS shared secrets and verify subscriber account status in billing.
resolution_steps.condition: If authentication requests timeout against central credential stores.

outcome_evidence: Customer-confirmed observed improvement with successful captive portal login and service access.
applicability: Applies to networks utilizing central RADIUS authentication for multi-service delivery.

title: IPTV stream stalling caused by broadband MTU fragmentation
complaint: High-definition IPTV streams freeze every few minutes while web browsing functions normally. Video playback recovers only after changing channels manually.

attempted_actions.evidence: Rebooting the set-top box did not prevent recurring stream freezes.

observations: Path MTU discovery fails for large multicast video datagrams.
Router drops fragmented packets lacking correct flags.

resolution_steps.instruction: Adjust WAN interface Maximum Transmission Unit settings to prevent packet fragmentation.
resolution_steps.condition: If large video datagrams trigger ICMP fragmentation failure messages.

outcome_evidence: Customer-confirmed observed improvement with uninterrupted IPTV stream playback.
applicability: Applies to broadband connections requiring precise MTU tuning for large media packets.

title: Fixed voice caller ID corruption during broadband upload bursts
complaint: Incoming caller ID displays garbled characters or shows unavailable whenever large files are uploaded over the broadband connection. Standard voice conversations remain unaffected.

attempted_actions.evidence: Replacing telephone handsets failed to correct caller ID decoding errors.

observations: FSK caller ID signaling frequency overlaps with high broadband upstream tones.
Splitter isolation filters show degraded performance.

resolution_steps.instruction: Replace faulty central service splitter unit at the network demarcation point.
resolution_steps.condition: If FSK signaling data gets corrupted by broadband upstream frequencies.

outcome_evidence: Customer-confirmed observed improvement with accurate caller ID display during heavy data uploads.
applicability: Applies to analog voice lines experiencing frequency bleed from adjacent DSL upload bands.

title: Mobile data routing loops via fixed broadband backhaul
complaint: Mobile devices using Wi-Fi calling experience severe audio clipping and dropped connections. Traceroute diagnostics reveal a routing loop between the local gateway and the core network.

attempted_actions.evidence: Flushing local device ARP caches did not eliminate packet forwarding loops.

observations: Core router static route entries point to incorrect gateway interfaces.
TTL expiration counters increment rapidly on local subnet pings.

resolution_steps.instruction: Correct static routing table entries and remove redundant gateway pointers.
resolution_steps.condition: If traceroute diagnostics indicate persistent packet forwarding loops.

outcome_evidence: Customer-confirmed observed improvement with stable Wi-Fi calling and normal packet hop counts.
applicability: Applies to integrated fixed-mobile core networks affected by misconfigured static routes.

title: Broadband DHCP lease renewal failure after firmware update

observations: Gateway DHCP daemon crashes immediately upon receiving discover requests.
System log registers memory allocation faults in network services.

resolution_steps.instruction: Roll back gateway firmware version and clear corrupted lease database files.
resolution_steps.condition: If DHCP server daemon crashes immediately following firmware deployment.

outcome_evidence: Customer-confirmed observed improvement with automatic IP address assignment restored.
applicability: Applies to residential gateways experiencing software regression after updates.

title: IPTV multi-screen sync delay across mixed broadband nodes

observations: Switch IGMP snooping querier election conflicts across network switches.
Secondary receiver experiences packet queuing delays on unmanaged switches.

resolution_steps.instruction: Designate primary switch as static IGMP querier and eliminate unmanaged hubs.
resolution_steps.condition: If multicast stream delivery timing drifts across multiple set-top boxes.

outcome_evidence: Customer-confirmed observed improvement with synchronized audio and video across all receivers.
applicability: Applies to multi-room IPTV deployments requiring strict multicast traffic management.

title: Fixed voice line noise triggered by broadband Wi-Fi proximity
complaint: Placing a telephone call results in audible buzzing whenever high-speed Wi-Fi devices transfer large files nearby. The interference disappears when Wi-Fi radios are disabled.

attempted_actions.evidence: Wrapping telephone cords in ferrite beads failed to block high-frequency interference.

Analog voice card lacks adequate internal radio frequency shielding.

resolution_steps.instruction: Replace unshielded internal telephone drop lines with category-rated shielded twisted pair cable.
resolution_steps.condition: If RF emissions from Wi-Fi equipment induce audible noise in voice circuits.

outcome_evidence: Customer-confirmed observed improvement with zero background noise during phone calls.
applicability: Applies to premises with poorly shielded internal telephone cabling near wireless routers.

title: Mobile app provisioning failure due to broadband NAT timeout

observations: Gateway NAT session table times out idle TCP connections prematurely.
Keep-alive packet intervals exceed router firewall state expiration settings.

resolution_steps.instruction: Increase TCP connection state timeout thresholds in the router firewall configuration.
resolution_steps.condition: If persistent mobile app connections drop prematurely due to aggressive NAT timers.

outcome_evidence: Customer-confirmed observed improvement with seamless mobile app data synchronization.
applicability: Applies to broadband routers with overly aggressive NAT timeout configurations.

outcome_evidence: Customer-confirmed observed improvement with zero packet loss and stable media services.
applicability: Applies to broadband access loops suffering from intermittent physical layer errors.
